ms.text:
MP1
At least 3 different metals (or alloys) suggested
MP2
Correct circuit diagram to include test wire, power source, ammeter and voltmeter
MP3
Correct symbols used for ammeter and voltmeter.
MP4
Determine resistance of a wire by measuring potential difference and current
MP5
Repeat with at least two more wires of different material.
MP6
Key variables:
Any one from:
Length of wire
Diameter/thickness of wire
MP7
Table with columns for material, potential difference, current and resistance with correct units
